steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); })()

steps.name: cam-ld
steps.eval: (() => { const c=window.__three.controls, cam=window.__three.camera; cam.position.set(8.6,2.6,7.6); c.target.set(11.0,0.8,4.0); c.update(); })()

steps.name: cam-master
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const room=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>/master|main/i.test(r.name)||r.id==='mainBedroom'); const [x0,z0]=room.origin; const cx=x0+room.width/2, cz=z0+room.depth/2; const c=window.__three.controls, cam=window.__three.camera; cam.position.set(cx+0.3,5.2,cz+2.4); c.target.set(cx,0.4,cz); c.update(); })()
